name: Interfaces & Microstructure Evolution
summary: Studies surfaces and interfaces and the processes that reshape microstructure over time: recovery, recrystallisation, grain growth, coarsening and sintering.

topics.name: Surface free energy, surface stress and the Wulff construction
Grain-boundary structure: tilt and twist boundaries, CSL model, boundary energy and mobility
Interphase interfaces: coherent, semi-coherent and incoherent
Triple junctions, dihedral angles and wetting
Adsorption and segregation to surfaces and grain boundaries
Recrystallisation: nucleation, growth, kinetics and recrystallisation diagrams
Normal and abnormal grain growth; Zener pinning
Particle coarsening: Ostwald ripening and LSW theory
Microstructural instabilities: spheroidisation and Rayleigh instability
Texture evolution during deformation and annealing
Introduction to sintering as capillarity-driven evolution
Quantitative microstructure description: stereology, grain-size distributions
